title: South American tour with Benny Goodman
summary: He recalls his only South American tour with Goodman, where passports revealed players' real names.

story.theme_name: Working for Benny Goodman: the leader and his bands
story.community_name: Working for Benny Goodman: the perfectionist bandleader

blocks.x: Well I think we've just about covered everything and unless there's anything any closing thoughts now.
Well not too many. I was just thinking about my only trip I made to South America.

That was about eight years ago. Another good friend of mine, Nick Travis was in the band. Now he, he's gone. This was with Benny Goodman you know. We made a tour of all the Latin Countries and that was something. That was different from everything else.
What did you do mostly? Play one concert in each city or.....
And what sort of response did you get?

Very nice. The only thin, when we got there you know they took all our names off the passport, our passports. Well you know, you didn't know who was who. Nobody knew I'm trumpeter Wilbur Clayton. (LAUGHTER). And all of those names nobody knew who in the heck was all these funny names. They just took the whole names off of the passport and put them up on the wall. Somebody was called Mousey Alexander, we found out his name was Elmore. (LAUGHTER?). Elmore Alexander on the drums I worked with Benny in the Waldorf Astoria. That was another hectic thing. Every night he fired somebody.
